q: The Riesz representation theorem for C(K) (K compact Hausdorff) identifies the dual space C(K)* with:
opts: The space of regular Borel signed measures on K, via Λ(f) = ∫ f dμ
The space of Borel probability measures
exp: Riesz-Markov-Kakutani: every bounded linear functional Λ on C(K) is represented by a unique regular Borel signed measure μ. For positive functionals, μ is a positive measure. This is foundational for weak-* topology on measure spaces.
